description: This file defines the HomeScreen widget for a Flutter news app. It manages a tabbed interface with different news categories, menu actions, and navigation to other screens like Saved News and Device Token. It also reacts to application state such as loading and error messages.

classes.name: HomeScreen
classes.description: A StatelessWidget representing the main home screen with tab navigation for different news categories.

classes.name: _HomeMenuAction
classes.description: An enum defining the menu actions available in the app bar.

classes.name: _CategoryTabSpec
classes.description: A helper class for defining category tab specifications including title and widget.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the HomeScreen, including AppBar, Tabs, and TabBarView.
